theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ψ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (V Y' : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen V → ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → InjOn ψ V → (∀ y ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → MeasurableSet Y' → Y' ⊆ V → (∀ y ∈ Y', fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0) → (∀ y ∈ Y', G (ψ y) ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ∧ ∀ e, inner ℝ (G (ψ y)) (fderiv ℝ ψ y e) = fderiv ℝ F y e) → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → Measurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (Y' ∩ F ⁻¹' {t}), g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (Y' ∩ F ⁻¹' {t}), g x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in ψ '' Y', ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1]
